BJP National Team Rejig Reflects Uttar Pradesh Election Influence

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has announced a new national team, with the recent Uttar Pradesh elections appearing to influence its composition. Eight individuals from Uttar Pradesh have been included in the new team. This reshuffling is seen by some as an effort by the party to engage in social engineering.
